image_generation.prompt: Create a new 4:5 portrait abstract image. Reference is STYLE ONLY: soft blurry low-fi airbrush, broad diffused masses, fine grain and faint scan noise, color bleeding, low-resolution enlarged old digital wallpaper. Invent a different composition. No text, letters, glyphs, figures, faces, body outlines, objects, interiors, photography, 3D, hard edges, collage, fabric or wood microtexture. Entire image nonfigurative and softly out of focus, not empty gradient. Large translucent dusty pink veils drift apart over muted teal, an oblique dark wine mass thinning as its older color traces fall away. Unfinished echo-smudges descend and then unexpectedly return upward; an absurd gentle interruption with a missing connection. Romantic amber shadow leans into tense red-purple pressure then swerves toward cool creative blue. Displaced depth and broken recurrence reorganize the composition, pale tenderness between dense unrest, dreamlike broad bleeding masses.
